product.title: Fruit Green Family Matching Set - Polo Dresses & Shirts
product.descriptionHtml:
• Fabric: Soft textured polo knit; exact fiber composition was not visible in the supplied vendor evidence.
  • Family story: A clean, coordinated green look for mom, dad, girls, boys, and baby siblings.
  • Color reference: Fruit Green is a fresh light green shade with cream collar and cuff contrast plus a small heart accent.
  • Design details: Choose the polo dress, matching shirt, baby romper, or nursing-friendly outfit by Type and Size.
  • Care: Machine wash cold on gentle, line dry, do not bleach, and cool iron inside-out if needed.
  • Size range: Baby 66-90, Child 1-2Y-10Y, Mother S-2XL, Nursing S-XL, and Father M-4XL.

Fruit Green keeps the family matching moment simple and polished: soft green polo styling, cream trim, and a tiny heart detail that photographs sweetly without feeling fussy. The expanded variant set now follows the vendor purchasable rows for girls, boys, moms, dads, baby rompers, and nursing-friendly outfits.

The supplied vendor chart publishes garment measurements for the dress and shirt tables, while baby romper and nursing rows are included from the operator-supplied purchasable inventory evidence and clearly documented in the saved listing notes.

Key Features:

  • Full family size run: Dress, shirt, romper, and nursing outfit options are separated by Type.
  • Chart-backed core rows: Girl dress and boy shirt sizes 80-150 use the newer vendor measurement screenshot.
  • Fresh polo color: Soft fruit green works for spring, summer, vacations, and casual portraits.
  • Draft-only safety: Kept unpublished for final merchandising review before launch.

Choose each garment type and size to build a crisp green matching look for everyone in the family photo.
